artworks.title: Jay and Finch
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two birds in a natural setting with a landscape in the background. The image features two birds prominently in the foreground, one labeled "Pica glandaria" and the other "Auruitis", perched on branches or logs. Detailed textures of their feathers are rendered with intricate lines and shading. In the background is a landscape showcasing rolling hills, a distant mountain, and a river winding through the scene. Buildings, including a stone bridge, are nestled amidst the foliage. To the left, a grapevine with clusters of grapes ascends elegantly. The use of black and white emphasizes the delicate linework and cross-hatching typical of classic illustrative art styles.

artworks.title: Pigeon and Finch
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration with two birds perched on branches. One bird, identified as "Columbus plumpes vittatus," is on the left, while the other, labeled "Picus cinereus," is on the right among berry-laden branches. The background includes buildings and trees, creating a rural scene. The style features intricate linework and shading in black and white.

artworks.title: Two Grey Red-Tailed Parrots
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two large parrots, one on the left holding cherries in its foot and the other on the right sitting on a branch. The color palette is black and white, as it is an engraving. The parrot on the left is positioned slightly lower and turned towards the cherries, while the parrot on the right faces forward, perched atop a branch. In the background, there is a detailed landscape with buildings, trees, a shepherd, and a flock of sheep.

artworks.title: Ostrich and Crowned Crane
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate illustration of two birds, labeled "Struthio" and "Struthio ex China." The birds appear detailed, with finely rendered feathers. They are surrounded by lush foliage, including large leaves and fruit-bearing trees. In the background, there are additional trees, huts, and a small figure. The scene is created using strong, meticulous lines, giving a rich texture. The engraving uses a monochromatic palette to emphasize contrasts through shadows and dense lines, creating depth. The background includes another ostrich, a person climbing a tree, and a lion, contributing to an exotic landscape.

artworks.title: Peacock and Stork
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a scenic view blending natural and architectural elements. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, capturing the landscape. The horizon features distant mountains and buildings with towers, suggesting a town or city. A peacock displays its detailed plumage on the left, while a stork stands near tall grasses on the right. In the background, a cityscape with towers and an arched bridge is seen against mountains. The style is characterized by intricate line work, typical of etching, accentuating texture and detail. The monochrome color palette of black and white emphasizes line contrast and complexity.

artworks.title: Guinea Fowl and Pheasant
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two birds in a rustic setting. One bird on the left is labeled "Gallina Africana" and appears to be a guineafowl with a plump body and speckled plumage. The bird on the right is labeled "Phasianus" and resembles a pheasant with ornate feather details and a long tail. Both birds are depicted with intricate linework typical of classical illustration. In the background, there is a rural scene with a thatched-roof house, trees, and bushes. The overall aesthetic is reminiscent of old-world natural history engravings, showcasing a detailed study of avian life in a pastoral landscape.

artworks.title: Waxwing and Another Bird
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white engraving of two birds on plants and branches. The birds are detailed with precise engraving lines, displaying intricate feathers. A landscape with water, a sailboat, a town, and hills is visible in the background. The engraving includes a town with buildings, a bridge, and hills with foliage far away. The horizon is in the middle, where the town meets the sky. The engraving uses lines and hatching for texture and depth, with a monochromatic palette providing contrast. A palm tree on the left and another plant on the right balance the composition. The sky has soft clouds, enhancing the peaceful atmosphere.

artworks.title: Kestrel and Great Spotted Woodpecker
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two birds labeled "Falco" and one perched on the ground. The color palette is monochromatic with tones of brown and gray. The background features a village, a church, mountains, and a body of water.

artworks.title: Horned Cock and Turkey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rooster and a turkey in a bucolic landscape. The drawing features two birds prominently in the foreground: on the left, a rooster labeled "Gallus cornutus," and on the right, a turkey labeled "Gallus Indicus." The background showcases a detailed landscape with rolling hills, a waterfall, and an architectural structure. The foreground is detailed with flora, including trees and other plants. The entire composition is rendered in black and white with intricate line work, highlighting textures and details in the feathers of the birds and the surrounding scenery.

artworks.title: Magpie and Another Bird
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts two birds on a branch surrounded by detailed foliage. In the distance, there are trees and rural buildings creating a village scene. The engraving style features fine linework, emphasizing texture in the birds and surroundings. The color palette is black and white, enhancing the details in the scene.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative title page with various birds and motifs. The image features an intricately designed cartouche with the text "AVIVM VIVAE ICONES, in aes incisae & editae ab Adriano Collardo." Surrounding the central text are detailed illustrations of birds, cherubs, flowers, and butterflies. The cherubs are positioned symmetrically on either side, each holding rods. Birds, including peacocks and other avian species, are perched around the frame, interspersed with floral and ornate decorative elements. The composition is balanced with detailed textures and lines, typical of engravings and etchings from earlier centuries. The overall style suggests a Baroque influence with elaborate and ornate detailing.

artworks.title: Saint Stephen
artworks.medium: charcoal on blue paper (now faded) heightened with white chalk
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person from the chest up. The person's head is tilted slightly back, looking up. Their facial features are delicately rendered, with a thoughtful expression and slightly open mouth. The person has receding hair at the front and curly hair at the sides. They are wearing a garment with a high collar and a scarf tied around the neck, holding a long, slender object in one hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A Magnificent Palatial Interior
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash with graphite over red chalk, touches of black chalk on laid paper, incised
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gertrude Laughlin Chanler
artworks.description: The image shows intricate lines and shapes creating elaborate arches and architectural structures. The drawing has a swirling and overlapping design that suggests chaotic motion within a grand structure. The abstract assembly resembles a grand cathedral or a palatial hall, with arches and columns akin to classical architecture. Figures and decorative flourishes are interspersed throughout, resembling statues or ornate carvings typical of an embellished building.

artworks.title: Faith and Charity
artworks.artist: François Boucher after Giovanni Battista Gaulli
artworks.medium: black chalk counterproof on oatmeal paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Regina Slatkin
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures and symbols like a cross. The drawing depicts several figures interacting around larger figures. The central focus is on a young figure holding a cross while other figures surround them, some looking upward or reaching towards the cross. The image is done predominantly in pencil with delicate lines and shading to create form and texture. The figures are dressed in flowing garments, and the overall composition suggests movement and divine interaction.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Amphitrite
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The central figure is seated on a large scallop shell, surrounded by flowing drapery and cherubs. On each side, there are figures of mermen blowing conch shells and other sea creatures emerging from the ocean waves. The composition is dynamic, with elaborate detailing in the rendering of the sea and figures, giving it a sense of movement. The sepia-toned drawing is executed with delicate line work and wash shading, evoking a classical underwater mythology scene.

artworks.title: Royal Coat of Arms of Louis XV
artworks.artist: Pierre François Tardieu or Jacques Nicolas Tardieu after François Boucher
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: This is a artwork of cherubs and angels surrounding a crowned emblem. The scene contains classical and allegorical symbolism, with winged figures set against swirling clouds. At the center, the emblem displays a crown above three fleur-de-lis symbols and laurel branches on either side. The composition features figures draped in flowing garments, set against grand architectural columns.

artworks.title: The Newly Elected Doge Presented to the People in San Marco
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection, David K.E. Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the interior of a grand cathedral with ornate architectural detailing. The depiction showcases architectural elements, such as high vaulted ceilings adorned with frescoes and paintings including angelic figures. Large columns support extensive archways, contributing to a sense of grandeur. In the foreground, there is a crowd of people in various poses, suggesting movement and interaction. A prominently decorated chandelier hangs in the center of the nave, drawing the eye upward towards the detailed ceilings. The artwork captures a lively atmosphere within the cathedral, filled with a sense of awe and reverence emphasized by the crafted interior space.

artworks.title: Second Livre de Trophés Culs de Lampes et Devises: Title Page
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.8 x 12.9 cm (8 3/16 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural title page featuring a highly decorative border with intricate patterns and motifs, including draped cloths, columns, and floral elements. Centered at the top is an arch under which a cloth is draped, held by two figures of classical appearance. Urns with smoke or steam rising from them are on either side. In the center, the text states "SECOND LIVRE de Trophés Culs de Lampes et devises Inventés par Gillot et Gravés par Huquier." At the bottom of the page, another figure appears to be sitting on a ledge, holding a hammer. The composition reflects a classical and ornamental style typical of title pages from the 18th or early 19th century, emphasizing symmetry and elegance.

artworks.title: Designs for Tail-Pieces: pl. 7
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.6 x 13 cm (8 1/8 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: The image features various etched decorations in a 3x3 grid format. The top left shows a cow's head with horns and laurel leaves. Top right includes a horn, a musical instrument, and a plate of food on a table. Middle left features a tipped-over urn surrounded by plants. Center right shows a decorative vessel with two birds. The lower left shows a sun and moon motif above intertwined items with leaves. The bottom right displays a shield with foliage and crossed arrows.

artworks.title: Designs for Tail-Pieces: pl. 8
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.5 x 13 cm (8 1/16 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of nine decorative emblematic designs organized in a grid. Each emblem features intricate arrangements of various objects and motifs with classical or ornamental themes. These include crests, escutcheons, laurel wreaths, ribbons, and various tools. The designs exhibit ornate flourishes and detailing typical of a baroque or classical style, suggesting a focus on symmetry and elaborate embellishments. The drawing likely served as an illustration or template for decorative art or architecture, showcasing how various symbolic elements can be combined to create appealing ornamental motifs.

artworks.title: Designs for Tail-Pieces: pl. 10
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.5 x 13 cm (8 1/16 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various decorative motifs and designs. The image consists of six distinct emblematic and ornamental designs, each occupying a section of the paper. The top left motif depicts a radiating sun-like emblem with a smooth central orb and curvilinear extensions on either side. At the right is an ornamental depiction possibly resembling a lion's face, framed by elaborate foliage or feathers extending upwards in a fan-like pattern. Below, the left-side design features a wreath encircling a radiant oval shape, mounted atop a highly stylized, ornate plinth with a foliate flourish. The middle-right motif presents a diamond-shaped frame containing a fleur-de-lis, accented by leaf-like appendages. Moving downward, the bottom left spotlights an intricate, vertical centerpiece possibly representing a fountain-like structure, with a vase grounded in floral, scroll-like embellishments. Lastly, the lower right showcases a simple arrangement of crossed trumpets and rolled scroll within a ribbon-tied bundle. The style of drawing suggests a baroque influence with rich detail and ornamental flourish.

artworks.title: Arlequin pleurant
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an individual posing as a harlequin character. The person is standing with one leg slightly forward, the right arm bent upwards and hand touching the nose. They wear a mask with exaggerated eyebrows and a large mustache, a soft hat, a fitted jacket, baggy pants with a sash at the waist, and slipper-like shoes. A bat or wooden paddle is tucked into the sash. In the background, sketched foliage and a lightly clouded sky are visible.

artworks.title: Arlequin Glouton
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a person wearing a Harlequin costume sitting on a drum. They are holding a pointed object to their chest with one hand and gesturing towards their neck with the other hand. The person's face is obscured by a mask with a prominent nose and round eyes, with a large hat on top. They are wearing a patterned costume with long sleeves and pants, along with close-fitting shoes. The background features a natural landscape with clouds and foliage.

artworks.title: Scaramouche
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a character named Scaramouche in a dynamic stance. He has one arm extended to the side and the other near his waist. Scaramouche has long, wavy hair, a thin mustache, and a beard. He is dressed in a fitted costume with trousers, shoes with bows, a ruffled collar, and a belt. The background includes stylized trees and a cloudy sky.
